For a 50-person Indian company, switching is relatively easy if you use a self-serve platform, but harder when migrating approvals, employee profiles, GST details and negotiated fares.

Provider	Cost structure	Switching difficulty	Key trade-off
MakeMyTrip myBiz	No annual subscription; booking costs/fare-specific charges apply	Low	Fast setup; employee invite + policy configuration. GST invoices, corporate fares and expense tools included. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1

Yatra for Business	Custom/transaction pricing; no public standard rate	Low–Medium	Stronger managed-service tiers; Travel Pro targets companies under ₹5 crore annual travel spend. 
Yatra.com

EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	Custom/transaction pricing	Low–Medium	Centralised bookings, negotiated rates, expense management and 24/7 support; setup involves company/account configuration. 
EaseMyTrip

Practical switching cost: budget 1–3 weeks for a 50-person rollout, mainly for employee onboarding, travel-policy setup, GST configuration and testing.

What to compare before switching: booking/service fees, cancellation markup, credit period, GST-credit handling, 24×7 human support, negotiated corporate fares, and whether existing traveller data can be imported.

For an Indian SaaS startup prioritising long-term value:

Option	Best for	Cost/value
Razorpay Subscriptions	Most startups	Subscription add-on currently 0.5% + standard payment fee. Strong UPI, cards, eMandate, retries and international support. 
Razorpay
+1

Cashfree Subscriptions	India-heavy SaaS	Excellent UPI AutoPay + eNACH + cards. Particularly attractive for Indian recurring collections; pricing includes mandate/presentation fees. 
Cashfree
+1

Chargebee	Complex/global SaaS	Best billing engine for usage-based, seat-based and hybrid pricing, revenue workflows and global scale. Starts at $99/month + usage/revenue fees on its Flow plan. 
chargebee.com

My pick: Razorpay for a typical early-stage Indian SaaS. Choose Cashfree if UPI/eNACH success is critical. Move to Chargebee when billing complexity, international expansion and finance automation justify the higher cost.
